why: Lenore (SLG 1998-2007, 13; CV 22998 / GCD 19028) stays with the 13 'Lenore v1 01-13' files 109571-109583; the 11 'Lenore 001-011 (2009-2014)' files 109584-109594 (26-30pp) are Titan's Lenore volume 2 (CV 41875 #1-11 / GCD 53104) and move to a run of their own; 'Lenore 001 (2019)' 111880 is Titan's 2019 Lenore (CV 120560 / GCD 178490) and moves to a third run

Rai (Valiant 1992-1995, #0-33; CV 4828 / GCD 4493) stays with the 34 _Chronological Valiant issues; the 2014 Rai's three books 110907 (Deluxe Edition Book 01, collects GCD 80415 #1-12), 110909 (#16) and 110910 (Vol. 04 4001 A.D., collects #13-16) move to a run keyed 'Rai (2014)' (CV 73417 / GCD 80415) - respelled from 'Rai v3 (2014)', the key those three files already carry (L-336); the 2019 Rai's Book 01 / 02 (110911 / 110912, collect GCD 152850 #1-10) move to 'Rai v4 (2019)' (CV 122982 / GCD 152850). S14359 RAI Companion is a separate 1-file handbook, not either run

Solar, Man of the Atom (Valiant 1991-1996, 60; CV 4607 / GCD 4256) stays with the 60 chronological issues and the two 1997 Acclaim one-shots 111098 / 111099 (residue); Dynamite's Solar: Man of the Atom (2014-2015, 12; CV 73103 / GCD 80249) - issues #9-12 (21664-21667) and its Vol. 01 / Vol. 02 trades (21668 / 21669, collecting GCD 80249 #1-4 and on) - moves to a run of its own. S5607 / S103858 are Doctor Solar (Dark Horse 2010 / Gold Key 1962), other runs

Smurfs (Papercutz 2010-, CV 50583 / GCD 60513) stays with its Vol. 00-26 and the 2013 FCBD 109330 (residue); item 109339 'The Smurfs (2014, FCBD)' 32pp is CV 73592 issue 452078 / GCD 74272 row 1204062, exactly the book S19639 stores (lookup --shelf 19639: stored cv=73592, gcd=74272, key 'The Smurfs Silver Book') - a second rip of it, so it joins S19639

Blade Runner 2019 (Titan 2019-2020, 12; CV 120232 / GCD 148828) stays with its Vol. 01-03 trades (two rips of Vol. 01) and the FCBD 2020 one-shot (residue); item 110060 'COL Blade Runner 2039 Vol. 01 - Luv (2023)' 105pp collects Blade Runner 2039 #1-4, the run S2865 stores (lookup --shelf 2865: cv=146794 / gcd=193782, key 'Blade Runner 2039', holding #9-12 and Vol. 02) - it joins S2865
